brief: Two-storey frame house of 1827 in the German colonial manner: five bays, side-gabled roof, shuttered windows and a small gabled hood over the centre door. Plain clapboard, stone foundation, a garden fence along the street. Record: 1 photo plus 4 measured drawing sheets (plans, elevations, details).

facade.notes: the Kappel House (Zoar, 1827): a five-bay two-storey frame I-house with shutters and end chimneys, a small hip-roofed entry porch with trellis sides and sawn brackets; a slanted cellar door; close to an unpaved street

why.note: the I-house of the Ohio German villages
